About.title: About Us
About.description: We build modern, customer-centric E-commerce experiences powered by technology, transparency, and trust.
About.p1: {siteName} was founded in 2025 with the desire to create an online marketplace, where could buy and sell goods, offer services and so on. Our mission is to be most trusted and comprehensive online platform, helping accelerate the country’s transformation to a modern digital society. We connect people with the goods, services, and opportunities they need to enhance their everyday lives. By offering a safe, efficient, transparent, and accessible marketplace
About.p2: Our team of expert developers, designers, and strategists work tirelessly to create custom solutions that help our clients streamline their operations, increase efficiency, and drive growth.
About.p3: At {siteName}, we believe in the power of technology to transform businesses and improve lives. We are committed to staying at the forefront of technological advancements and delivering exceptional value to our clients.

Faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faqs.description: Find answers to the most common questions from our customers.
Faqs.q1_title: Does the platform handle delivery of my order?
Faqs.q1_content: No. {siteName} is an online marketplace that connects buyers with sellers. We do not provide shipping, logistics, tracking, or delivery services. All delivery arrangements, costs, and timelines are the sole responsibility of the seller and the buyer.
Faqs.q2_title: Who is responsible if my package is lost, damaged, or delayed?
Faqs.q2_content: The seller is responsible for proper packaging and shipping of your order. As a buyer, you are responsible for verifying the seller's reliability before purchasing. {siteName} does not assume any liability for shipping issues, delays, or damages during transit.
Faqs.q3_title: What should I do if a seller doesn't ship my order?
Faqs.q3_content: If a seller fails to ship your order, you should contact them directly to resolve the issue. {siteName} provides a marketplace platform for transactions but does not control or enforce seller shipping timelines. We recommend purchasing goods only from official and verified sources to ensure product authenticity and a reliable shopping experience.
Faqs.q4_title: Can I choose my own courier or shipping method?
Faqs.q4_content: Yes. Sellers are free to choose any courier, postal service, or delivery method. {siteName} does not require or recommend specific shipping providers. Sellers are fully responsible for fulfilling orders and providing shipment details to buyers.

HowItWorks.page_description: Step-by-step guides to help you create stores and add products with ease.
HowItWorks.section_1_title: How to register as a seller and create a connected Stripe account. This is a must if you want to sell products, because sales revenue will be transferred to this account after confirmation.
HowItWorks.section_1_step_2: Click on User Avatar in the header
HowItWorks.section_1_step_3: Click on Account Settings from the sidebar menu
HowItWorks.section_1_step_4: Click on Register on Stripe as a seller button
HowItWorks.section_1_step_5: Fill in the required information on the Stripe page and submit
HowItWorks.section_2_title: How to login Stripe dashboard as a seller
HowItWorks.section_2_step_2: Click on User Avatar in the header
HowItWorks.section_2_step_3: Click on Account Settings from the sidebar menu
HowItWorks.section_2_step_4: Click on Login to Stripe Dashboard button
HowItWorks.section_3_title: How to create a new store
HowItWorks.section_3_step_2: Click on MyStores in the header
HowItWorks.section_3_step_3: In the right side of the header, open the store dropdown menu
HowItWorks.section_3_step_5: After creation, you can edit store details in "Store settings" from the sidebar
HowItWorks.section_4_title: How to create a new product
HowItWorks.section_4_step_2: Click on MyStores in the header
HowItWorks.section_4_step_3: Open the store dropdown menu on the right side of the header
HowItWorks.section_4_step_4: Select the store where you want to add a product
HowItWorks.section_4_step_5: From the left sidebar, go to Products
HowItWorks.section_4_step_6: Click Create to add a new product
HowItWorks.section_5_step_2: Click on Shop in the header
HowItWorks.section_5_step_4: Click on Checkout button and complete your purchase
HowItWorks.section_6_step_2: Click on Avatar icon in the header
HowItWorks.section_6_step_3: Select My orders from the sidebar menu
HowItWorks.section_6_step_5: Click on an order to see details
HowItWorks.section_6_step_6: You can confirm receipt of your purchase by clicking Confirm button from details modal if you are the buyer or the admin of the store from which the product was purchased.
HowItWorks.section_7_title: How to see your sales products as a seller
HowItWorks.section_7_step_2: Click on Avatar icon in the header
HowItWorks.section_7_step_3: Select My sales from the sidebar menu
HowItWorks.section_7_step_5: Click on a sale to see details
HowItWorks.section_7_step_6: You can confirm receipt of your purchase by clicking Confirm button from details modal if you are the buyer or the admin of the store from which the product was purchased.
HowItWorks.info_block_intro: MyStores is your personal seller dashboard. It is designed for users who want to sell products, manage inventory (create and manage stores, products, categories, brands and colors), and track store sales performance — all in one place.
HowItWorks.info_block_my_stores_intro: From the MyStores section in the header, you can:
HowItWorks.info_block_item_3: Create product categories, brands and colors
HowItWorks.info_block_item_6: See how many products are available and sold
HowItWorks.info_block_outro: Each store has its own dashboard where you can monitor sales, manage content, and make data-driven decisions to grow your business.
